# What the Release workflow installs to build the files it publishes to PyPI:
# build, the hatchling backend, and every package they need on Linux with
# Python 3.12. Every package is pinned by hash and installed with
# --require-hashes --no-deps, and the build runs with --no-isolation, so
# nothing unpinned runs in the job that makes the wheel and the sdist.
# Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) opens a pull request for each update.
